notes.title: Notes on upcoming new contents - 10/28/2014
notes.content:
Notes on upcoming new contents - 10/28/2014

Hello everyone, 

First of all, I would like to apologize about delayed contents update and announcements. As you might already know, we have launched GunZ 2 in South East Asia last month. We’ve been focused on the project for the past few weeks, and we are now ready to push the next contents update on Steam for you all.
We have prepared 24 new items all equipped with brand new features that will bring a huge impact to the gameplay.

See below for details of the new gears.

The latest technology developed by scientists of NAU enabled soldiers to use their optimite energy when handling firearms. By doing so, they can use special abilities installed on the weapons.

Ivan
Optimite Crime Buster MK I
[X-ray Scope] Scope zoom sees through objects. (Constantly consumes ZP)

Optimite Crime Buster MK II
[Lock and Load] Waiting for 3 seconds in scope zoomed in activates Lucky Bullet. (Replaces original Lucky Bullet)

Optimite Curved Blade MK I
[Typhoon] Cyclone Kick is enhanced with powerful spinning attack. (Consumes 2 ZP bars / can be casted in mid-air only)

Optimite Curved Blade MK II
[Lightning Blast] Smash combo (MLB > MRB) is replaced with powerful lightning blast attack.


Rena
Optimite Dual Tiger Teeth MK I
[Quick Play] Increases reloading speed. (Aim shot requires max ZP)

Optimite Dual Tiger Teeth MK II
[Precision Spray] Aim shot does not slow down movement speed but slightly decreases aim rate.

Optimite Royal Daggers MK I
[Decoy Dance] Rena's decoy moves forward attacking her enemies.(Rena cannot attack while creating her decoy)

Optimite Royal Daggers MK II
[Chain Rush] Shadow Rush skill's cooldown time resets if an enemy is killed from skill damage. (Skill cooldown time is increased)


Elena
Optimite Spitter MK I
[Precision Strike] Grenade shells can be detonated by pressing R button. (Grenades do not explode upon contact with targets.

Optimite Spitter MK II
[Fire Skipper] Grenade shell explodes and bounces off group 4 times. (Reload time increased)

Optimite Baton MK I
[Shockwave] Hammerfall is enhanced with 3 consecutive explosion instead of 1. (Explosion damage gets smaller over the course)

Optimite Baton MK II
[Determination] After taunting motion, Elena can use powerful unblockable attack with mouse right button. (Replaces Launch Attack)


Wayne
Optimite Eagle Eye MK I
[Roulette] One round per each clip does greater damage. (Disables Fast Draw)

Optimite Eagle Eye MK II
[Auto Aim] One Shot One Kill locks on targets automatically, but max target number decreases.

Optimite Anaconda Tail MK I
[Arms Robbery] Grabbing an enemy temporarily neutralizes enemy's weapon.

Optimite Anaconda Tail MK II
[Mad Cowboy] Upon casting Extermination, Wayne charges forward attacking all enemy targets in his way. (Cannot turn direction)


Max
Optimite Undertaker MK I
[Explosive Round] Fires explosive rounds instead of the conventional bullet. (Cannot move while firing)

Optimite Undertaker MK II
[Recycled Rounds] Idling the gun regenerates ammo.

Optimite Legion Shield MK I
[Shielddozer] Max charges 3 times upon casting Shield Charge. (Skill damage decreases over the course)

Optimite Legion Shield MK II
[Light Leap] Shield Shock consumes only 1 ZP bar. Shield Shock can be cased in air. (Skill damage is reduced)


Rose
Optimite TDW-4 MK I
[Guided Rocket] Fired rocket traces after the target Rose's crosshair is pointing. (Firing rate decreased)

Optimite TDW-4 MK II
[Multishot] Rose can fire upto 3 rockets at once by pressing and holding Fire button. (Movement speed is decreased while charging shots)

Optimite Survival Knife MK I
[Humongous Fall!] Skill damage of What you got in there? is also increased by 50% but chances to trip also increases to 100%

Optimite Survival Knife MK II
[Kaboom!] Jump slash triggers an explosion and damages all nearby enemies.


We’ll be have a few rounds of testing period to finalize these new items for the next 3 to 4 weeks, and then prepare for release. Again, I apologize about the prolonged delay in contents update.

- Guntrix -

notes.title: Maintenance & Contents Update Schedule - 07/10/2014
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We have an extensive balance update as well as a new character class update scheduled today.

Maintenance Schedule: 
July 10 03:00 PST – July 10 04:30 PST

Please refer to below patch notes for details of the update.

Contents Updates
- Rose, the Rocket Trooper joins the battlefield.
Rose is an extraordinary teenager from Iron Legion who likes rocket, explosion, and teddy bear. She uses rocket launcher from distance and shotgun in close combat. She is a powerful ranged fighter but she may struggle in melee fights.

- Steam friend list is available in GunZ 2 now.

Your Steam buddies will now appear on your friend list in game.
You can easily invite your friends into your game now.

- Added Daily Mission feature

You will be given 3 random missions every day.
Complete each mission to get rewards.
You can view your daily missions in Achievements menu.

- Fixed clan name bug which made it impossible to use the same clan name after deleting. The same clan name can be used 1 week after deleting the clan.

- EXP requirement for reaching level 20 has been reduced to half.
- 20% Discount Sale Event!
To celebrate introduction of Rose, we will continue the sale event until next weekend (July 20)

Balance Updates: Common changes

Default armor set’s total AP value has been increased from 60 to 85.
You can now use Aerial Dodge when struck by launch attack while you’re in mid-air.
Changes on ZP acquisition:

Amount of ZP gained from incoming damage is now based on any damage type whereas you only gained ZP from damage on HP previously.
(ZP gain from damage on HP -> ZP gain from any damage taken)
Amount of ZP you get from successful critical hit has been reduced by half.
Amount of ZP you get from consecutive kills has been reduced.
Amount of ZP you get from multi-kill has been reduced.
You now get ZP from at last strike of your combo attack whereas you previously gained ZP every 5th successful hit. (regardless of melee or ranged combo)
(ZP gain from every 5th hit -> ZP gain from last hit of a combo attack)
You no longer gain ZP from launch attack.
You now gain ZP when assisting a kill. ZP amount from kill assist is half of ZP gain from a Kill.

Character motion length of damage from grenade launcher has been reduced by half. You now can quickly get back to the battle after being hit by grenade explosion.


Balance Updates: Class specific changes
- Ivan

Duration of invincibility after casting Cyclone kick reduced from 0.5 to 0.2 seconds.
Bonus damage ratio of regular melee combo has been slightly reduced.
Bonus damage ratio of launch attack combo (MLB>MLB>MLB>MRB) has been slightly increased.


- Rena

Last attack of Rena’s regular combo now penetrates all type of defense including shield.
Critical chance bonus of Honed Razor has been increased from 10% to 20%.
Bonus damage ratio of melee attack and combo attack has been slightly increased.
Bonus damage ratio of launch attack has been reduced from 1.5 to 1.0.
Cooldown time of Shadow Decoy has been decreased from 6.5 to 5.5 seconds.
Shadow Rush now has 1 second super armor effect when casted.
Aim rate bonus of right clicking when dual pistol is equipped has been increased from 30% to 40% but it does not zoom in any more.


- Elena

Enemy detection duration of Intuition has been increased by 1 second.


- Max

Max now puts his weapons on his back when wall-running.
- Max runs faster when wall-running with flame-thrower or minigun. However, he falls from the wall if he attacks with them.
Enemies hit by dash-jump attack now bounces off the ground instead of being knocked down on the ground.
Increased level of super armor when firing minigun from 1 to 2. Sniper rifle or grenade launcher does not stop him from firing minigun any more.
Duration of Shield Rush’s super armor status has been increased from 0.5 to 1.0 second.


- Wayne

Enemies grabbed by Wayne’s whip then attacked by jump grab or Black now takes appropriate damage motion
Aiming radius of One Shot One Kill skill has been increased. Total length of aiming is also reduced from 2 to 1.5 seconds.
Black Snake now has super armor effect for 1 second.
Revolver’s effective range of damage has been increased.
Overall Damage per Second of lever action rifle has been increased but reload time has been slightly increased. 
Effective range of damage of all lever action rifle except for Defender 808 series has been reduced.
Ammo clip size of Rapid Shooter series has been reduced from 6 to 5.
Rapid Shooter series’ aiming rate now decreased when shooting continuously.



The game servers will be closed during the maintenance. 
We’re sorry about the down-time and will do our best to reopen the game servers as soon as possible. 

- GunZ Team

Contents Updates
- Rose, the Rocket Trooper joins the battlefield.
Rose is an extraordinary teenager from Iron Legion who likes rocket, explosion, and teddy bear. She uses rocket launcher from distance and shotgun in close combat. She is a powerful ranged fighter but she may struggle in melee fights.

- Steam friend list is available in GunZ 2 now.

Your Steam buddies will now appear on your friend list in game.
You can easily invite your friends into your game now.

- Added Daily Mission feature

You will be given 3 random missions every day.
Complete each mission to get rewards.
You can view your daily missions in Achievements menu.

Default armor set’s total AP value has been increased from 60 to 85.
You can now use Aerial Dodge when struck by launch attack while you’re in mid-air.

Amount of ZP gained from incoming damage is now based on any damage type whereas you only gained ZP from damage on HP previously.

Amount of ZP you get from successful critical hit has been reduced by half.
Amount of ZP you get from consecutive kills has been reduced.
Amount of ZP you get from multi-kill has been reduced.
You now get ZP from at last strike of your combo attack whereas you previously gained ZP every 5th successful hit. (regardless of melee or ranged combo)
(ZP gain from every 5th hit -> ZP gain from last hit of a combo attack)
You no longer gain ZP from launch attack.
You now gain ZP when assisting a kill. ZP amount from kill assist is half of ZP gain from a Kill.

- Ivan

notes.title: Wayne the Strider #2
notes.content:
http://cloud-3.steampowered.com/ugc/468681270775569510/30206F76A30B9F3960DB99335FCDC83B8F64440B/

Hi everyone. Venister here.

As I told you before, I’d like to share more details of Wayne. I explained about the basic movement and his melee weapon before. You can find out about them from the previous announcement. Today I’d like to reveal more about his ranged weapons.

Revolver

Strider’s unique weapon is Revolver, which deals significant damage to his foes. His special skill, ‘Fast Draw’, lets him cast critical hit on the first target he shoots after drawing revolver from the holsters. Fast Draw skill shot cannot be guarded with any melee weapon, either. There is also down side of this weapon. Since it’s not an automatic firearm, you need to fire each of your bullets carefully. If you need high DPS at once, you would have to click fast. Revolver is also weak in long ranged battle since it is optimized for short and mid ranged combat situations.

Lever Action Rifle

Lever Action Rifle is another unique weapon of Wayne’s. It’s very similar to sniper rifle but it does not have zoom functionality. It has accurate aim and is designed to be used in long ranged battle. Enemies shot with lever action rifle also get stunned for a moment just like sniper rifle does. Its delay is shorter than sniper rifles but deals lower damage than sniper rifle, and the effective range is shorter than sniper rifle, too.

More Details on Tumbling

Advantages of Tumbling: Distance that you can move with tumbling is longer than dash. It also grants super armor status so it cannot be interfered with any melee attack. Tumbling’s passive also reduces damages that you take from your enemies.

Disadvantages of Tumbling: You cannot change the direction of your movement while you're tumbling. Tumbling is also slower than dashing. Toggling between ranged and melee weapons while tumbling is also very difficult.


I would like to say that the upcoming update will be huge in size. We’ve made a number of changes on game balance and added more stylish combos. Also, as I’ve mentioned before, the network code will be further optimized. This update will be made before arrival of Wayne, and we will post another announcement with more details of the next update very soon.

Thank you.

notes.title: Thank you for playing and all your support.
notes.content:
Hello, I am Venister, CEO of MAIET.

I’d like to thank all of you who support our game despite that there is a lot that the game lacks. Although it has not been a smooth sail till now, it has been a full month since the launching of Early Access of GunZ 2. Today, I would like to share some insights of the status quo of GunZ 2 service.

First, the size of our development team is quite small. They’ve been working really hard developing the game, and they’re trying even harder trying to make GunZ 2 a better game. Although the team of 25 staff has been working day and night trying to cover as much as they could, there is still a lot that the game needs improvement on. I feel deeply sorry that the outcome is not being made as fast as all of us wants, but I can assure you that we will keep making improvements on GunZ 2 even though it may be slow.

As we launched GunZ 2 on Steam, we have been facing countless problems which we have never come across before. Publishing and operating a commercial service is something that we have never experienced since the company was founded. We were lost at first and went through lots of unexpected issues, but we still think the whole journey has been a very exciting experience. The fact that we are dealing with our fans face-to-face without a publisher in the middle is also very encouraging as well.

Let me talk a little bit about some of the issues that many of you are discussing on forums for the time being.

1. Balancing

Balancing issue is not something that can or should be changed just because someone complains, ‘this character is seriously over-powered.’ Everyone can have a different opinion on balancing, so it requires data analysis. We plan on publishing statistics data regarding character balance, so let us discuss together then.

2. Custom Game Mode

Like our staff have stated before, Custom Game is already available in the game, but it is only disabled for now. We disabled it because we want our players get used to auto-matching game first. Before we open Custom Game, we will fix problems of auto-match system such as match queue taking too long where there are a small number of players on the queue. We also think custom games can be abused for many ill purposes. Hence, there custom game rewards will be quite small even when it’s open. We only want to open it for the community.

3. Event

The MVP events we recently held were small in many aspects and scale. Since it was the first event content we tried, it’s been a bug feast and it still needs a lot to be worked on. We are aware of that win count didn’t get registered properly for some players due to a bug, but it’s very hard to make it up for these players currently. We are also aware of that hack users and their friends are abusing the system. These current issues will be addressed soon. We will resolve the problems as soon as possible and make it up to everyone with better events. Once the current issues are resolved, we will enhance the event contents with more variety and better rewards.

Lastly, let’s talk about k-style for a little bit.

Like we have mentioned a number of times already, there is nothing to reconsider about k-style. We do not intend to reproduce it just like that of GunZ 1. However, like some of you may have already found out, there is a feature that triggers animation/motion cancelation for each character. For instance, if you swap your weapon to a ranged weapon right after flipping an enemy with melee weapon, the second action cancels flip motion and lets you fire your ranged weapon right away. It is not easy to come up with a general rule for these, and it requires a lot of manual labor to balance them out. We might even end up having to change animation/motion rules while we try to keep each of them under control. However, if we find players’ suggestion interesting and free from any balance issue, we will definitely implement it in the game. Most important thing here is that all in-game motions should be well balanced among all character classes, and we will fix it if the balance is broken.

Once again, I’d like to thank you all how enjoy and support our game. I also hope you all get an item that you want with the Purified Crystals that we will give out for celebrating 1 month of game service. Thank you all.

- Purified Crystals will be available after the maintenence.
- Celebrating Gift: 10x Purified Crystals, 10x Purified Ore
